supportScreen.clientFaq1Q: How do I post a service request?
supportScreen.clientFaq1A: Tap "Request Service" from your dashboard or the quick actions menu. Fill in the service type, description, location, and budget, then submit.
supportScreen.clientFaq2Q: How do I find and hire a worker?
supportScreen.clientFaq2A: Use the Search tab to browse workers by category or skill. View their profile, ratings, and reviews, then send them a direct hire request.
supportScreen.clientFaq3Q: How do I make a payment?
supportScreen.clientFaq3A: Once a worker completes a job, you will be prompted to release payment. You can pay via mobile money, bank transfer, or other linked payment methods.
supportScreen.clientFaq4Q: How do I rate a worker?
supportScreen.clientFaq4A: After a job is marked complete, you will receive a prompt to rate and review the worker. You can also rate them from your job history.
supportScreen.clientFaq5Q: What if the worker does not show up?
supportScreen.clientFaq5A: Contact our support team immediately. We will help mediate and, if necessary, help you find a replacement worker as quickly as possible.
supportScreen.clientFaq6Q: How do I cancel a service request?
supportScreen.clientFaq6A: Open the service request from My Requests, tap the menu icon, and select Cancel. Note that cancellation policies may apply depending on the job status.
supportScreen.clientFaq7Q: How do I update my payment method?
supportScreen.clientFaq7A: Go to Profile, then Payment Methods. You can add, edit, or remove payment methods from there.
supportScreen.clientFaq8A: Yes. All payment data is encrypted and we never store full card numbers. We comply with PCI-DSS standards to keep your financial information safe.
supportScreen.workerFaq1A: Keep your profile, trades and ID up to date so you get verified. Clients can then book you directly, and our team assigns you to requests in your trades - you get a notification and can accept or decline. Professional workers can also browse open jobs from the dashboard.
supportScreen.workerFaq2Q: How do I update my profile?
supportScreen.workerFaq2A: Go to Profile tab, tap "Edit Profile" button, update your information, skills, and experience. Don't forget to upload your documents for verification.
supportScreen.workerFaq3A: Direct hire requests are job offers sent directly to you by clients who found your profile. You'll receive notifications when you get these requests on your Dashboard.
supportScreen.workerFaq4Q: How does the payment system work?
supportScreen.workerFaq4A: Once you complete a job, the client marks it as complete and releases payment. You can view your earnings in the Earnings tab and request withdrawals to your linked bank account.
supportScreen.workerFaq5Q: How do I verify my documents?
supportScreen.workerFaq5A: Upload your National ID and any professional certificates from the Documents section. Our admin team will review and verify them within 24-48 hours.
supportScreen.workerFaq6Q: Can I work for multiple clients?
supportScreen.workerFaq6A: Yes! You can accept multiple jobs and work with different clients simultaneously. Just manage your availability status and schedule accordingly.
supportScreen.workerFaq7Q: What if I have a dispute with a client?
supportScreen.workerFaq7A: Contact our support team immediately through this Help Center. We'll mediate the dispute and help resolve any issues between you and the client.
supportScreen.workerFaq8Q: How do I withdraw my earnings?
supportScreen.workerFaq8A: Go to Earnings tab, ensure you have a linked payment method, and click "Withdraw Funds". Minimum withdrawal amount is $50. Funds typically arrive within 3-5 business days.
